newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU public grain stocks total 1.77 mln tns end 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: EU public grain stocks total 1.77 mln tns end 1996/97.

text.p: European Union intervention grain stocks fell to 1.77 million tonnes net when offers closed on May 31, from 2.60 million tonnes a year ago, an EU source said on Thursday.
The source added that another 333,000 tonnes of grain was still on offer, which if accepted would bring the total stocks to 2.10 million tonnes gross.
The total under offer included 161,000 tonnes proposed in the final week for intervention grain offers in all member states except Sweden, where the deadline is end-June.
A breakdown of stock figures, which are due to be presented at a weekly meeting of the cereals management committee on Thursday, was not immediately available.
"The stocks are relatively small," said the source, adding that high market prices and low interest rates encouraged farmers to hang onto their grain.
"New crop prices are above intervention levels," the source said, adding that farmers were hopeful they could sell their old-crop grain at attractive prices.
Common wheat prices were between 5.0 and 13.0 percent above intervention levels in Germany and between 2.0 and 10.0 percent higher in France, the source noted.
